keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Orri Óskarsson (Real Sociedad).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Real Sociedad).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Giorgi Tsitaishvili (Rayo Vallecano) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Real Sociedad 0, Rayo Vallecano 0.
Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Beñat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Gonçalo Guedes replaces Takefusa Kubo.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Héctor Fort replaces Jon Aramburu.

Goal! Real Sociedad 1, Rayo Vallecano 0. Orri Óskarsson (Real Sociedad) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ander Barrenetxea with a through ball following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Job Ochieng replaces Ander Barrenetxea because of an injury.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Jon Gorrotxategi replaces Beñat Turrientes.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Jozhua Vertrouwd replaces Adrià Pedrosa.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Gnangoro replaces Unai López.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Isi Palazón replaces Mujaid Sadick.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Randy Nteka replaces Sergio Camello.
Substitution, Real Sociedad. Sergio Gómez replaces Aihen Muñoz because of an injury.
Gnangoro (Rayo Vallecano) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Rayo Vallecano. Alemão replaces Jozhua Vertrouwd.
Second Half ends, Real Sociedad 1, Rayo Vallecano 0.
